critique: The render has the correct basic ingredients for a Point Rise preset: a white particle point on black that grows into a small rising particle cluster. Motion from t1 to t4 is upward, but it is very subtle, and the result reads more like a compact, roughly radial puff than a clearly directional rising point stream. The low opacity and 2 px particle size also leave the early frame nearly invisible.

suggestions.why: Increase emitter velocity so the upward progression is clearly visible across adjacent frames rather than remaining a nearly stationary cluster.
Tighten directional spread to make the particles read as a focused point rising upward instead of a spherical burst.
